fsm_states_esm.description: Initial state after power-up / hard reset. No mailbox, no process data. Only ECAT-side register access via FPRD/FPWR/BRD/BWR to ESC registers; PDI access also possible. Transitions Out → PreOp (on AL Control write 0x02), → Boot (on AL Control write 0x03).

Pre-Operational — mailbox SyncManagers (SM0/SM1) are active; CoE/SoE/EoE/FoE/AoE/VoE protocols can be exchanged; process-data SMs and FMMUs are NOT yet active. Transitions: → Init (AL Control 0x01), → SafeOp (AL Control 0x04, after SubDevice validates SM2/SM3/FMMU configuration), → Boot (AL Control 0x03).

Safe-Operational — process-data SMs and FMMUs are active; Input process-data is generated by SubDevice from valid hardware reads; Output process-data is received but NOT applied to hardware (outputs remain in user-configured Safe State). Transitions: → PreOp (AL Control 0x02), → Op (AL Control 0x08), → Init (AL Control 0x01).

Operational — full bidirectional cyclic process-data exchange; SubDevice drives application hardware from Output process-data. Process-Data Watchdog (PD WD) is armed; if no LWR/LRW arrives within the timeout, SubDevice automatically transitions Op → SafeOp + Error. Transitions: → SafeOp (AL Control 0x04 OR PD WD expiry), → Init (AL Control 0x01).
Bootstrap state — firmware update via FoE on the mailbox SMs. Process-data and ESM operation are suspended. Transition: → Init (AL Control 0x01 after firmware download complete).

fsm_transitions_esm.trigger: MainDevice FPWR 0x0120 = 0x04, SubDevice validates SM2/SM3/FMMU config
MainDevice FPWR 0x0120 = 0x08, SubDevice arms PD watchdog
MainDevice FPWR 0x0120 = 0x04, OR PD watchdog expiry

fsm_states_esc_on_the_fly_engine.description: No frame on any port; ESC waits.
Frame Start-of-Frame detected on Port 0 (or another port); receive into shift register.
Parse Cmd / Addr / Length / Next; determine address-match (AP/FP/BC/LOG).
If addressed, perform read+modify+write on the in-flight bytes; otherwise pass through transparently.
If addressed and operation successful, increment Working Counter (+1 read, +2 write, +3 RW).
Transmit modified frame out on the next active port (or loop back if no link).
Frame transmitted; engine returns to IDLE.

fsm_states_mainDevice_cyclic_engine.description: BRD AL Status sweep + APRD to enumerate SubDevices (Position-based).
APWR Configured Station Address on each SubDevice.
Read each SubDevice's ESI EEPROM via 0x0500-0x050F.
FPWR DL Control, SM0/SM1 (mailbox), DC RX-Latch enable.
FPWR 0x0120 = 0x02 to every SubDevice; verify via BRD 0x0130.
FPWR SM2/SM3 (process data), FMMU0..FMMU2 (logical mapping), DC SYNC config.
Cyclic LRD/LWR/LRW datagrams + per-cycle ARMW for DC distribution + periodic FPRD AL Status diagnostic.
Decreased WKC / AL Status error / link loss → diagnose + recover or de-energize.

fsm_states_mailbox_handshake.description: SM0 Mailbox-Out buffer empty (Mbx_Out Empty bit = 0).
MainDevice writes a complete mailbox message into SM0 via FPWR; hardware sets Mbx_Out Empty=1 when finished.
SubDevice CPU reads SM0, processes the request (e.g. CoE SDO Read of Object Dictionary), and writes the response into SM1.
Hardware sets Mbx_In Full=1; MainDevice polls (BRD 0x0805 Status) and reads SM1 via FPRD.
If the SubDevice times out, the MainDevice may resend the original message with the Counter field incremented; SubDevice de-duplicates on Counter.

fsm_states_distributed_clocks.description: DC unit inactive; ESC operates without distributed time.
MainDevice broadcasts a BWR to 0x0900 to latch RX timestamps on every port; then FPRD reads each SubDevice's RX times to compute propagation delays.
MainDevice writes per-SubDevice System Time Offset (0x0920) and System Time Delay (0x0928).
Cyclic ARMW: reference SubDevice writes its local time into the datagram; every following SubDevice reads it and updates its local System Time.
SubDevice Activation 0x0981 set; SYNC0 / SYNC1 outputs generate pulses at programmed period.

anti_deadlock_rule: ESM transitions only on MainDevice request via AL Control 0x0120 with one exception: PD Watchdog expiry forces Op → SafeOp. SubDevice never escalates state autonomously beyond the safe direction (toward Init / SafeOp). The mailbox handshake on SM0/SM1 is atomic on the wire (SyncManager hardware enforces buffer integrity); a half-completed mailbox write cannot be observed by the SubDevice CPU. The on-the-fly engine has no internal queues; one frame in, one frame out, deterministic latency.
fsm_hints: ESM and on-the-fly engine are fully implementable as small synchronous state machines clocked at the wire rate (100 MHz / 1 GHz for EtherCAT G). FMMU lookup is a sorted-window compare against the 8 entries; SyncManager arbitration is single-buffer per channel. DC PI loop converges within 100-1000 cycles; pre-computed propagation delays let the first SYNC0 fire within microseconds of activation.
